funnel.title: Move people through the funnel
funnel.text: Move at least 5 people past “New lead”: write to them, invite them, warm them up.

nextSteps.title: A next step for everyone
nextSteps.text: Give at least 5 people a next step and a date. They then appear in My day and in your plan of the day on their day.

scripts.title: Scripts and auto-plans
scripts.text: Press “Add ready-made scripts” (18 texts for every stage), rewrite them to your voice and turn on an auto-plan for a stage, so the next step fills itself in.

weekGoals.title: The week's targets
weekGoals.text: Set the week's targets (reached, presentations, clients). The app counts the facts by itself.

firstDay.title: Your first day by the plan
firstDay.text: Open My day, close 3 steps from “To do today” and press “Done”. This is how the daily rhythm begins.

groups.title: Groups
groups.text: Split the long list into groups and subgroups: cold market, warm market, a city.

partners.title: Partners and the team
partners.text: Move the first person to the Partner stage and name their sponsor (you can pick “Me (my account)”): the team tree and the network map build themselves.

invite.title: Invite your first person
invite.text: Share your link: a person who leaves their contacts becomes a card in your CRM, and a person who joins MeetOwl gets their own workspace and brings you a bonus point.

kb.title: Knowledge base
kb.subtitle: How things work and how to build a daily routine.

category.rhythm: Rhythm of the day and week

kb.pick: Choose an article on the left.
kb.untranslated: This article is shown in English: it has not been translated into your language yet.

teams.title: Teams
teams.hint: A team groups members and can give them CRM access together: shared people, or everything. A member's own level is kept; the better of the two counts.
teams.name: Team name
teams.deleteConfirm: Delete the team {name}? Its members keep their own access.
teams.exists: A team with this name is already there

share.title: Who has access
share.nobody: Nobody else has been given access.
share.noCandidates: No one left to give access to. Members need CRM access first (Settings → Members).
share.error_grantee_no_crm: Give this member access to the CRM first (Settings → Members).
share.error_self_share: Access is given to somebody else.

profile.phoneBad: Enter a phone number with 6 to 15 digits.
profile.telegramBad: Enter a Telegram name like @name or a link like t.me/name.

referral.title: Your invitation link
referral.hint: Send it to people you know. Whoever creates an account through it appears in your people as a new lead, and you get a notification.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.subtitle: Everyone who has an account: how they registered, what they own, who invited them. Their clients and projects are not shown.
admin.name: Name
admin.history: What was done to this account
admin.restore: Let the account sign in again
admin.suspendConfirm: Block {name}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until you let them back.
admin.suspendNote: Blocks signing in and ends open sessions. Nothing is deleted.
admin.modeHint_off: Everyone has everything for free; no trial, no limits, nothing can be bought.
admin.modeHint_preview: Only workspaces of the people in PAID_PLANS_PREVIEW_EMAILS live under the paid rules; everyone else has everything.
admin.modeHint_on: The paid rules apply to everyone: Free limits, Pro locks, the trial and payments.

sharing.title: Show my activity to my sponsor
sharing.hint: {name} invited you. If you agree, they see a summary of your activity: numbers (people added, reached, presentations, calls and meetings, tasks) and the date of your last action. Never your clients' names, messages or notes.

setup.title: Connecting the platform
setup.intro: Once, you register MeetOwl with Google, Slack and Telegram and paste the keys into Vercel. After that anyone connects everything with one button, with no code.
setup.vercelNote: Settings go into Vercel: the project → Settings → Environment Variables, then Redeploy.
setup.httpsWarn: The address of the platform is {url}, and it must start with https:// (set APP_URL in Vercel). Telegram, Google and Claude work only over https.

value.webhookUrl: Telegram webhook address (the app sets it itself)

inngest.title: Background jobs (Inngest)
inngest.why: Without it notifications, reminders and nightly recalculations do not run; Telegram and the calendar need it.
inngest.s1: Open app.inngest.com and sign in with GitHub (you already have the account).
inngest.s2: Manage → Event Keys → create a key and copy it.
inngest.s3: Manage → Signing Key → copy the key. Never paste keys into chats.
inngest.s4: In Vercel add INNGEST_EVENT_KEY, INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY and JOBS_MODE with the value inngest.
inngest.s6: In Inngest press Sync new app and paste the address below. The functions will appear in the list. Then press Check here.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.why: One bot for everyone: people link their chat in one press and get notifications and commands.
telegram.s2: Give the bot a name and a username that ends with bot (for example MeetOwlBot).
telegram.s3: BotFather sends a token. It is like a password: copy it and show nobody.
telegram.s4: In Vercel add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (the token), TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME (the username without @) and TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (any long string of letters and digits you make up).
telegram.s6: Press Check here. If it says the bot is not connected, press Connect the bot: the app tells Telegram where to send messages.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.why: Meetings from MeetOwl in Google Calendar, and changes from Google back.
google.s1: Open console.cloud.google.com and sign in. Create a project called MeetOwl.
google.s2: APIs & Services → Library → Google Calendar API → Enable.
google.s3: OAuth consent screen (Google Auth Platform): user type External, app name MeetOwl, your e-mail for support.
google.s5: Audience: add yourself as a test user, then press Publish app (status In production). Otherwise Google resets access every 7 days.
google.s6: Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application. In Authorized redirect URIs paste the address below exactly.
google.s7: Copy the Client ID and Client secret and add them in Vercel as GOOGLE_CAL_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CAL_CLIENT_SECRET. Redeploy, then press Check.

slack.title: Slack
slack.why: New leads, won deals and red projects announced in a channel.
slack.s1: Open api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch. Name MeetOwl and pick a workspace.
slack.s2: OAuth & Permissions → Redirect URLs → add the redirect address below.
slack.s3: Scopes → Bot Token Scopes: chat:write, chat:write.public, channels:read, users:read, users:read.email.
slack.s4: Event Subscriptions → On → Request URL: the events address below. Subscribe to the bot events app_uninstalled and tokens_revoked.
slack.s5: Basic Information → copy the Client ID, Client Secret and Signing Secret and add them in Vercel as SLACK_CLIENT_ID, SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET and SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET. Redeploy.
slack.s6: Manage Distribution → activate public distribution, so that any workspace can install the app. Then press Check.

claude.title: Claude
claude.why: People ask Claude in a chat and it works in MeetOwl for them. Nothing to register.
claude.s1: Nothing to set up: it works as soon as the address of the platform is https.
claude.s2: People copy the address from the Claude card on the Integrations page. Press Check to be sure.

result.https: The address of the platform must start with https://. Set APP_URL in Vercel and redeploy.
result.inngest_keys: The Event Key or the Signing Key is not added yet.
result.inngest_mode: The keys are there, but JOBS_MODE is not inngest. Add JOBS_MODE = inngest and redeploy.
result.inngest_ok: Ready. Also make sure the app is synced in Inngest (Sync new app): its functions should be listed.
result.telegram_keys: The bot token or the webhook secret is not added yet.
result.telegram_token: Telegram does not accept this token. Copy it again from BotFather.
result.telegram_username: Add TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME: the username of the bot {name} without @.
result.telegram_mismatch: TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME does not match the bot of this token: it is {name}.
result.telegram_webhook: The token is right, but Telegram does not send messages here yet. Press “Connect the bot”.
result.telegram_ok: Ready: the bot @{name} is connected and delivers messages here.
result.google_keys: The Client ID or the Client secret is not added yet.
result.google_id: The Client ID does not look right: it should end with .apps.googleusercontent.com.
result.google_ok: The keys are in place. The full check is the first real connection on the Integrations page.
result.slack_keys: One of the three Slack keys is not added yet.
result.slack_ok: The keys are in place. The full check is the first real connection on the Integrations page.
result.claude_ok: Ready: the address is https, people can connect Claude.
